mapper.update: INSERT INTO major_shareholder (merge_key, name_major_stakeholders, shareholding_ratio) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{nameMajorShareholders}, #{shareholdingRatio}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO finance_shareholder (company_id, finance_id, major_shareholder_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) SELECT c.company_id, f.finance_id, ms.major_shareholder_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN finance f ON f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} JOIN major_shareholder ms ON ms.merge_key = #{mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, finance_id, major_shareholder_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE finance_shareholder.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR finance_shareholder.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id

UPDATE finance_shareholder fs SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company c JOIN finance f ON f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} WHERE fs.company_id = c.company_id AND fs.finance_id = f.finance_id AND c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND fs.deleted = false

UPDATE finance_shareholder fs SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company c JOIN finance f ON f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} WHERE fs.company_id = c.company_id AND fs.finance_id = f.finance_id AND c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND fs.deleted = false AND fs.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid

UPDATE finance_shareholder fs SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company c JOIN company_finance cf ON cf.company_id = c.company_id WHERE fs.company_id = c.company_id AND fs.finance_id = cf.finance_id AND c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND cf.deleted = true AND fs.deleted = false
